info.title: AuraPix Tenant Webhook Secret Rotation API
info.description: Per-tenant webhook signing-secret rotation with a graceful dual-secret window. During the configurable grace window (default 24h, capped 7d) outbound metering deliveries include TWO comma-separated `v1=` signatures in `X-AuraPix-Signature` so receivers can validate against either the new or the previous secret while they cut over. After the window the previous secret is purged automatically. Issue #161.

post.summary: Rotate (or mint) a tenant's webhook signing secret
post.description:
Generates a fresh signing secret. The previous secret remains valid for the configured grace window so receivers can verify either signature during cut-over.

The plaintext secret is returned EXACTLY ONCE in this response. The caller MUST persist it now; it is not recoverable later.

Auth: host API key with the `webhooks.write` scope, scoped to the target `tenantId`.

200.description: Newly minted signing secret + metadata. Plaintext returned once.

400.description: Validation error (e.g. graceSeconds out of range)

get.summary: Return metadata about the tenant's webhook signing secret
get.description:
Returns `createdAt`, `rotatedAt`, `fingerprint`, and an optional `previous` block when a rotation grace window is active. NEVER returns the plaintext secret; the only way to retrieve a plaintext value is via the rotate endpoint immediately after minting.

Auth: host API key with the `webhooks.write` scope, scoped to the target `tenantId`.

404.description: No signing secret has been minted for this tenant

graceSeconds.description: Seconds the PREVIOUS secret should remain valid for dual-signing. Default 86400 (24h). Capped at 604800 (7 days). Values outside the range respond with 400.

createdAt.description: When the current secret was minted.

fingerprint.description: Stable, non-reversible identifier for the current secret (truncated SHA-256 hex).

rotatedAt.description: ISO-8601 of the last rotation event.

previous.description: Present only inside the rotation grace window. Outbound deliveries include a second signature for this secret in `X-AuraPix-Signature`.

secret.description: Plaintext signing secret. Returned EXACTLY ONCE; the value is not recoverable after this response.

fingerprint.description: Stable identifier (truncated SHA-256 hex) for the new secret.

rotatesAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the PREVIOUS secret will stop being used for dual-signing. Equals `createdAt` on the initial mint (no prior secret to dual-sign with).

previous.description: Metadata for the previously active secret retained during the grace window. Null on the initial mint.

oneOf.description: Legacy shorthand error string from upstream auth middleware.
